programmes.d: Tony is threatened with criminal negligence after the son of a prominent lawyer hangs himself in his cell.
Vinnie jeopardizes his cover by going to the cops to get them moving on what he knows was murder.
When the cops put the heat on Sonny Steelgrave and bust up some of his secret deals, he smells a rat in the inner circle — and Vinnie finds himself suspect.
After his mother is mugged in Brooklyn, an enraged Vinnie sets out to find the punk who did it.
Hunter and McCall enter the world of baby brokering when the murdered body of a call girl and an unharmed two-year-old are left in front of the woman's television set.
While investigating the apparent suicide of Hunter's friend from the Vietnam War, the pair uncovers a 20-year-old betrayal that is still killing people today.

Tony sets out to trap a serial rapist in a Santa Claus mask who's been terrorizing the city.
Rachel refuses to believe Tony when he tells her that her school teacher colleague is a child molester. Meanwhile, Tony has forgotten it's Rachel's birthday.
After receiving a pair of baffling death threats, Tony initiates around-the-clock surveillance of his unsuspecting family.
Sonny's cruel punishment of a lounge singer who wants out of his contract triggers a cascade of events that leads to Vinnie being photographed with McPike.
Vinnie learns that the wedding of a syndicate boss' daughter is just a pretext for a bloody gang war.
